svg.text: One agent’s prefill freezes the swarm, or it doesn’t
Eight agents decoding on one 16 GB RX 9070 XT while a ninth arrives with a 1,730-token prompt. Same work, two schedules.
Monolithic prefill — the whole prompt runs in one iteration
GPU fully occupied · every decoder waits
8.3 s freeze — no agent emits a token
Chunked prefill — 128-token slices, decodes piggyback on every iteration
agent 9’s first token still lands at ≈ 8.5 s — about 3% later than monolithic
